blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The local government of Minglanilla in southern Cebu has announced that it will cancel its annual Christmas party this December. Mayor Lheslen Enad said the funds allocated for the event will instead be realigned to support the town’s El Niño preparedness and response initiatives, although she did not disclose the amount.
